        	<div class="banner-layer wow fadeInUp" data-wow-delay="300ms">
                <img decoding="async" src="https://www.kitesurfing.at/wp-content/themes/kitesurfing/assets/images/Layer-banner.png" alt="">
            </div>
            <div class="banner-overlay" data-background="">
            	<img decoding="async" src="https://www.kitesurfing.at/wp-content/themes/kitesurfing/assets/images/banner-cut.png">

            <div class="breadcrumbs-outer">
                <div class="container">
                    <ul class="breadcrumbs"><li><span><a href="https://www.kitesurfing.at/en/">kitesurfing.at</a></span></li><li><span><a href="https://www.kitesurfing.at/en/kitecamps/">Kite Camps</a></span></li><li><span>Kite Camp Rhodes</span></li></ul>                </div>
            </div>
        </section>        <section class="content-part section8 banner-bg pt-xl-100 pb-xl-100 pt-lg-80 pb-lg-80 pt-50 pb-30" data-background="">
            <div class="banner-overlay" data-background=""></div>
            <div class="container">
                <div id="" class="content-title center-align pt-md-100 pt-50 mb-md-0 mb-30">
                    <h1><strong>COME JOIN US AT THE GET HIGH KITE CAMP WITH KITESURFING.AT IN THEOLOGOS, RHODES!</strong></h1>
                    <p>
<h6><strong>At the right time, in the right place.</strong><br>
Greece—especially Rhodes—is a real thermal powerhouse during the height of the European summer! There’s a very good chance of days with strong winds, plenty of culture, and absolutely delicious food. This kite camp offers you everything you need. And even more!</h6>
</p>
                </div>
                <div class="content-row pt-md-50 pt-30">
                    <div class="row">
                                            </div>
                </div>            </div>
        </section>
    <section id="verleihboxen" class="content-part section12 pt-md-100 pt-50 pb-0">
        <div class="sidebar-img-six" data-background="">
            <img decoding="async" src="https://www.kitesurfing.at/wp-content/themes/kitesurfing/assets/images/Quotes-Top-Swoosh-blue-light.png">
        </div>
        <div class="content-inner-row bg-dark-blue01 pb-md-0 pb-50">
            <div class="container">
                <div class="content-row pb-md-30">
                    <div class="row">
    <div class="col-lg-4 col-md-6 col-sm-12 col-12">
        <div class="content-blog mb-30">
<p><span class="div-icon bg-blue mb-15"><img decoding="async" src="https://www.kitesurfing.at/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/icon2.png" alt="" ></span></p>
<h4 class="white-color mb-md-20 mb-15">Getting Here</h4>
<p class="p1">After a pleasant, short flight—for example, 2 hours and 30 minutes from Vienna—we land at Rhodes Airport. We then take a taxi (approx. €20) to our accommodations (about a 15-minute ride). We’d be happy to help you arrange your trip! If you have any questions about flights, airport transfers, or anything else, please feel free to contact us.</p>
</div>
<div class="content-blog mb-30">
<h4 class="white-color mb-md-20 mb-15">Accommodations</h4>
<p class="p1">The Hotel Sabine is just a 4-minute walk from our spot and is situated on a lush, green property with its own restaurant, bar, and pool. The rooms are airy and bright, with balconies—some offering ocean views. The friendly staff at the front desk, along with a mini-market in the hotel lobby, are available 24 hours a day.</p>
</div>
<div class="content-blog mb-30">
<h4 class="white-color mb-md-20 mb-15">Meals</h4>
<p class="p1">Breakfast is included at the hotel. It’s a classic breakfast buffet with a cereal station, cakes and sweet pastries, eggs, cheese and cold cuts, fruits and vegetables, and, of course, plenty of feta and olives. At lunchtime, food is usually ordered to the beach. You can really have almost anything delivered to the kite school: fresh fruit or smoothies, iced coffee, pita gyros, club sandwiches, burgers, poke bowls, and much more.<br>
In the evening, we usually dine at a truly authentic Greek taverna.</p>
</div>
    </div>
    <div class="col-lg-4 col-md-6 col-sm-12 col-12">
        <div class="content-blog mb-30">
<p><span class="div-icon bg-blue mb-15"><img decoding="async" src="https://www.kitesurfing.at/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/icon3.png" alt="" ></span></p>
<h4 class="white-color mb-md-20 mb-15">Kite Camp</h4>
<p class="p1">From beginner courses to jump training and/or foil courses—we offer a customized selection of courses for every skill level.<br>
Thanks to a relaxed instructor-to-student ratio and the consistently reliable thermals, rapid learning success is guaranteed. The kitesurfing course is tailored to your progress without any time pressure. The focus of this camp is definitely on the hoped-for strong-wind days and the water depth at the spot. Together, these factors create the perfect setup for advanced big-air training. The water depth also provides a great opportunity to learn or improve your kite foiling skills.</p>
<p>Spot guiding is often the highlight of school trips. Thanks to our excellent connections at this unique kitesurfing spot, we’re sure to have everything we need. In collaboration with “Surfin Bird Rhodes”— <a href="https://surfingbird.gr"><span class="s1">https://surfingbird.gr</span></a> – we provide safety at the spot and unforgettable activities such as trips to other spots on the island, cliff jumping, beach parties at Surfin Bird, cultural excursions in Rhodes City, and much more!</p>
</div>
    </div>
    <div class="col-lg-4 col-md-6 col-sm-12 col-12">
        <div class="row">
<div class="col-lg-12 col-md-6 col-sm-12 col-12">
<div class="content-blog">
<p><span class="div-icon bg-blue mb-15"><img decoding="async" src="https://www.kitesurfing.at/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/icon4.png" alt="" ></span></p>
<h4 class="white-color mb-md-20 mb-15"><b>Dates</b></h4>
<div class="col-lg-12 col-md-6 col-sm-12 col-12">
<div class="content-blog">
<p class="p1">July 11–18, 2026<br>
July 18–25, 2026</p>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<h4 class="white-color mb-md-20 mb-15">Registration &amp; Booking</h4>
<p>Can't find the right opportunity for you? – Get in touch with us! We'll find something for you.<br><a href="mailto:office@kitesurfing.at">
office@kitesurfing.at</a><br>
<a href="tel:+4369919678682">+4369919678682</a></p>
<p class="p1">Our tour operator, RETTER Sports, offers an all-inclusive, worry-free package. If you have any questions about flights, travel arrangements, accommodations, or anything else, the RETTER Sports team will be happy to help you plan your trip.<br>
<a href="tel:+43 316 815415">+43 316 815415</a><br><a href="mailto:info@retter-sports.com">
info@retter-sports.com</a></p>
<p class="gray-color">For every kite camp booking, you'll receive a €25 gift certificate for the <a href="https://shop.kitesurfing.at/de/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">GET HIGH – Kitesurfing.at online store</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="col-lg-12 col-md-6 col-sm-12 col-12">
<div class="content-blog mb-15"></div>
</div>
</div>
    </div>
    <div class="col-lg-4 col-md-6 col-sm-12 col-12">
        <div class="content-blog mb-30">

<h4 class="white-color mb-md-20 mb-15">Kite Camp Only</h4>
<p class="p1">+ Spot Guiding<br>
+ Complete kitesurfing gear<br>
+ 6-day customized course<br>

        <div class="sidebar-img-six" data-background="">

            <div class="container">
                <div class="content-row pb-md-30">
                    <div class="row">
    <div class="col-lg-4 col-md-6 col-sm-12 col-12">
        <div class="content-blog mb-30">
<p><span class="div-icon bg-blue mb-15"><img decoding="async" src="https://www.kitesurfing.at/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/icon2.png" alt="" ></span></p>
<h4 class="white-color mb-md-20 mb-15">Windproof Package Rhodes</h4>
<p><strong>Is a 1-week kitesurfing vacation too short for you? Or too risky in terms of wind conditions? Play it safe and book a 2-week kitesurfing camp right away!</strong></p>
<p>6 days of instruction and up to 7 days of equipment rental, plus a wind guarantee if wind conditions are less than 50% of the expected yield. Flexible scheduling of modules based on wind and weather forecasts. Decide for yourself when you’d like to take advantage of your coaching.</p>
<p><em><strong>Get the most out of your kite camp!</strong></em></p>
</div>
    </div>
    <div class="col-lg-4 col-md-6 col-sm-12 col-12">
        <div class="content-blog mb-30">
<p><span class="div-icon bg-blue mb-15"><img decoding="async" src="https://www.kitesurfing.at/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/icon2.png" alt="" ></span></p>
<h4 class="white-color mb-md-20 mb-15">Performance</h4>
<p class="p1">+ Flights<br>
+ 14 nights in a double room<br>
+ Breakfast included<br>
+ Spot guiding<br>
+ Complete kitesurfing equipment<br>
+ 6 days of customized course offerings<br>
+ 7 days of supervised kitesurfing with equipment rental<br>
+ Flexible course scheduling<br>
+ Video analysis<br>
+ Equipment rental for independent practice for 13 days<br>
+ Workshops<br>
+ Goodie bags<br>
+ Wind guarantee if wind availability is less than 50%</p>
<p class="p1">Single occupancy in a double room starting at €2,800 per person</p>
</div>
    </div>
    <div class="col-lg-4 col-md-6 col-sm-12 col-12">
        <div class="content-blog mb-30">
<p><span class="div-icon bg-blue mb-15"><img decoding="async" src="https://www.kitesurfing.at/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/icon2.png" alt="" ></span></p>
<h4 class="white-color mb-md-20 mb-15">Inquiries</h4>
<p><em>Want to join us but still have a few questions? Please fill out the form, and we'll contact you personally. Are you also excited to fly over the water with us?</em></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

                    <div class="row">
    <div class="col-lg-4 col-md-6 col-sm-12 col-12">
        <div class="content-blog mb-30">
<p><span class="div-icon bg-blue mb-15"><img decoding="async" src="https://www.kitesurfing.at/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/icon2.png" alt="" ></span></p>
<h4 class="white-color mb-md-20 mb-15">"A" Package</h4>
<p><strong>Would you like to come along but don't want to participate in the kite camp? No problem—just "join in"! This package includes equipment rental for the entire week.</strong></p>
<p>You can plan your day however you like and take part in workshops and other activities (such as trips to other spots or other events). We’ll guide you through a relaxing stay at Surfin Bird Theologus (minimum VDWS Level 5 or equivalent = able to walk confidently on the slopes).</p>
</div>
    </div>
    <div class="col-lg-4 col-md-6 col-sm-12 col-12">
        <div class="content-blog mb-30">

<p class="p1">+ Flights<br>
+ 7 nights in a double room<br>
+ Breakfast included<br>
+ Spot guiding<br>
+ Complete kitesurfing equipment<br>
+ Beach access (+ storage)<br>
+ Workshops<br>
+ Goodie bag</p>
<p class="p1">Starting at €1,390 per person</p>
